scope: Active listed companies without imported statements
method: Exact NSE legal-name matches discover candidates only. The target CIN must appear in the NSE-linked annual PDF, and the NSE symbol must match the public Screener company page. Explicit annual standalone tables only; TTM and ambiguous bases are excluded. Crore values are converted to INR; displayed precision is retained. as_of is the matching NSE annual-report dissemination date; table retrieval is stored separately. Only gaps are filled; existing NSE statements are preserved.
